_comment: Last recorded size of each contract wasm, in bytes. scripts/check_wasm_growth.py warns (it never fails) when a build is more than tolerance_percent above these. coverage_ledger and reporter_registry are the measured sizes recorded in size-budgets.json (18017 and 6230 bytes); covered_vault is derived from its 5800-byte budget, which was set at the measured size plus about 20%. The upgrade fixtures compile their contract's lib.rs and match it. A deliberate size change should refresh this file in the same commit with `python3 scripts/check_wasm_growth.py --update`.
